description:
Azarozna Engineering Team

We are a subdivision of the Azarozna Group, a group specializing in humanitarian missions and exploring the world.

We, Azarozna's Engineering team, specialize in building health care solutions and technology for making earth exploration a safer space.
summary:
A-HAT is an all in one tool that let's astronauts keep track of their health while being on missions.
A-HAT utilizes it's own custom algorithm to understand the astronaut's vital data from the past 3 months before the mission and while on the mission.
A-HAT provides the astronaut detailed information and motivating messages to keep the astronaut on point and motivated to keep track with his fitness.

While being on long and tiring missions, fitness can seem to astronauts as just another box they have to cross of the list and pretty much not too useful of an action.
With A-HAT we plan to make that journey enjoyable, detailed and informative while also motivating so they can keep going with their fitness journey.
details: A-HAT requires before the mission to submit their last 3 months of daily vital data and combines with the vital data the astronaut submits while on mission, A-HAT understands how the astronaut's body and system works and provides them with detailed information regarding their current health situation and it helps motivate them while also keeping track of his fitness situation
